pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/100497

MV are treated as single values when the collection has actually only one value; when the collection has multiple values, the functions will return null.
pr_title: ESQL: Properly handle multi-values in fold() and date math
pr_comment: Hi @luigidellaquila, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: nit: Maybe we could mention in a small comment that this is how we handle MV fields.
